helpsWith: Checkout and thermal or emailed receipts, with offline-ready sales
Inventory tracking, barcode scanning, and purchase orders for suppliers
Customer store credit, debt tracking, and WhatsApp payment reminders
Shift tracking, cash drawer records, and sales, tax, and stock reports as CSV
howToStart: Click Sign up on hylen.store, create your shop account, and choose one of the three plans to start selling.

draftPricing.note: One plan at $39.99 per month, or $219.99 for 6 months, or $399.99 per year, with all features included and no per-terminal fees.

name: RingBooker
summary: RingBooker is an AI phone receptionist for salons and spas. It answers calls after hours and during busy times on your current number, and sends text follow-ups to recover missed bookings.
helpsWith: Answers after-hours and overflow calls on your current business number
Handles booking, reschedule, and cancel requests on the call
Sends automatic text-back to callers who hang up or call after hours
Gives call summaries and transcripts so your team knows what each caller wanted
howToStart: Start the 14-day free trial on the RingBooker pricing page, then forward your business line and follow the guided setup.

draftPricing.note: Starter is $79 per month plus tax where applicable (up to 100 captured calls), Professional is $149 per month (up to 200 captured calls), and a 14-day free trial is offered with no card needed to start.

name: Simple Salon
summary: Cloud software for salons and spas that handles online bookings, appointment book, point of sale, staff rosters, client records and reports. It runs in a web browser, so you can manage the salon from anywhere.
helpsWith: Online booking that fills your appointment book, with reminders and payments
Client records, memberships and loyalty points that stay with the business when staff leave
Reports on sales, stock, gift vouchers and popular services
Staff rosters and access levels so each person sees only what they need
howToStart: Click Start free 14-day trial on the Simple Salon website and sign up in your browser.

draftPricing.note: The page offers a free 14-day trial with no card required, but does not show any monthly prices, so the real plan cost is unknown from this page.
